stories.title: USA Softball International Cup — Medal Games TODAY

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
USA Softball International Cup medal games are TODAY at Devon Park, OKC.

WNT came back from 5-0 to beat No. 4 Canada 10-7. Elite run-ruled American Samoa. Sunday's semis: all-USA bracket + Canada vs. Japan.

Gold medals on the line. 🥎🇺🇸

#USASoftball

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
USA has won 11 of 14 International Cup gold medals all-time.

Today's medal games at Devon Park, OKC, could add to that record — both USA squads survived the semis (including an all-USA matchup Sunday night).

2027 World Cup qualification at stake. 🥎

#USASoftball

article.headline: Both USA Squads Are Here. The Gold Medal Games Are Today.
